messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The Cloud Nine lobby smells like coffee, floor polish, and fresh paint.

Nadia Bell drops a heavy key ring into your palm just as the mail cart begins rolling away by itself.

(Nadia Bell) "First rule of management: chase the thing with wheels before answering the phone."
